title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
description: Negotiations at the COP31 UN climate summit in Turkey are in deadlock, having run through the night, as countries remain unable to agree on a new global climate deal. In a late intervention on Friday, a group of countries led by France and Panama pushed back against the draft agreement which included no reference to reducing the world's demand for fossil fuels, reports the BBC. title: COP31 climate talks spill into overtime as nations quarrel over fossil fuels
description: ANTALYA, Turkey — The COP31 climate conference slipped into overtime on Friday as negotiators from nearly 200 countries struggled to bridge deep divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance. title: In 1956, a skeleton was found in an ancient Danish shell dump; 70 years later, fresh analysis suggests the man lived through the shift to farming 6,000 years ago while changing from a seafood-heavy diet
description: The remains of Rødhals Man were uncovered in a shell midden on Sejerø, shedding light on his dietary habits and way of life. Initial analysis reveals a seafood-based diet during his youth, evolving to include land-based food sources, likely due to nearby agricultural communities. His skeletal structure shows stress, suggesting a physically active life that adapted to these changes.
